	is_shown = { government_has_flag = government_is_kehillah kehillah_business_market_built_trigger = yes }
	valid_position = { government_has_flag = government_is_kehillah kehillah_business_market_built_trigger = yes }
	is_shown_character = { scope:employee = { kehillah_business_worker_trigger = yes } }
	valid_character = { scope:employee = {
			custom_tooltip = { text = kehillah_business_worker_tt kehillah_business_worker_trigger = yes }
			is_courtier_of = scope:liege
			house.var:kehillah_household_of = scope:liege.primary_title
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = kehillah_business_family_free_tt
				OR = { has_court_position = kehillah_business_market_position house = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_household_assignment_cooldown } } }
				house = {
					NOT = { any_house_member = { kehillah_has_business_position_trigger = yes NOT = { this = scope:employee } } }
				}
				NOR = {
					has_court_position = kehillah_business_dyers_position
					has_court_position = kehillah_business_silk_weavers_position
					has_court_position = kehillah_business_goldsmiths_position

					has_court_position = kehillah_business_glassmakers_position
					has_court_position = kehillah_business_clothiers_position
					has_court_position = kehillah_business_apothecaries_position

					has_court_position = kehillah_business_bankers_position
					has_court_position = kehillah_business_factor_position
				}
			}
		} }
	salary = { gold = 0 }
	received_salary = { gold = 0 }
	revoke_cost = { gold = 0 prestige = 0 piety = 0 }
	custom_employer_modifier_description = kehillah_businesses_effect_desc
	on_court_position_received = {
		scope:employee.house ?= { set_variable = { name = kehillah_household_assignment_cooldown value = yes years = 2 } }
		scope:liege = { trigger_event = kehillah_business.1 }
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = { scope:liege = { trigger_event = kehillah_business.1 } }
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		scope:employee.house ?= { remove_variable = kehillah_household_assignment_cooldown }
		scope:liege = { trigger_event = kehillah_business.1 }

	on_court_position_vacated = {
		scope:employee.house ?= { remove_variable = kehillah_household_assignment_cooldown }
